cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Told You Enough
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll go through my birthday honestly. When you rang, I was eating dinner alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your brother posted a photo from our kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right, we'll use the photo. He came for dessert; by dinner, I mean the main course.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's beside you while you're carving the chicken.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carving isn't eating. I meant the moments when food was actually in my mouth.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 controls an honest account; A3 accepts B chosen photo but defines dinner narrowly, and A5 narrows eating again when that evidence defeats the definition.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 photograph becomes A3 accepted basis; B4 carving photograph causes A5 mouth-only definition.

relationship.evidence: B2 supplies contrary evidence and B4 specifies exactly what it shows.

heightening.evidence: A5 reduces a whole meal to individual moments of ingestion, earned by B4 carving.

specificity.evidence: A1 birthday meal and B2 shared kitchen make the dispute legible; dessert attendance does not prove absence during carving.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 photo agreement changes the evidentiary method; A5 has no extra summary after the specific evasion.
